purpose: data-only check of Yahoo daily-bar availability and last valid OHLC bar relative to each official IDX delisting date
acquisition_method: GitHub Actions only; sandbox must not query Yahoo
retry_policy: Retry only rate-limit/transient errors with 30s, 120s, 600s, 600s waits. HTTP 404, empty-history and other non-transient errors are logged and not bypassed or replaced with another provider.
near_delisting_definition: A valid OHLC bar exists on or before official DeListingDate and the last valid OHLC bar on or before that date is no more than 30 calendar days earlier.
